name: emergency-mail-creator
description: Static website that creates alarm printouts (PDF) and Leitstelle mail texts. Only needed for checks and tests; the site itself has no build step.

scripts.validate: npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=true -s vehicles.schema.json -d vehicles.json && npx --yes ajv-cli@5.0.0 validate --spec=draft2020 --strict=true -s keywords.schema.json -r vehicles.schema.json -d keywords.json
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run check-data && npm test
